source.snippet: We are team of 6 members using the single org we are facing the difficulties like: We don't know who is pushing the code into the org. If Someone pushes the code the older version is being pushed. How to rectify the above scenario.

problem_statement: Small Salesforce development teams sharing a single org have no lightweight tooling to track who pushed code changes, prevent overwrite collisions, or audit change history — leading to lost work and broken deployments.
target_segment: Small Salesforce development teams (2–10 devs) at agencies or SMB ISVs without enterprise DevOps budgets
notes: Paid Salesforce org users experiencing recurring productivity loss. Enterprise solutions (Gearset, Copado) exist but are expensive; a lightweight audit/lock layer for small teams is a clear gap. Team of 6 implies a company context with a budget. Similar complaints appear repeatedly in Salesforce SE and community forums.
